IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Tuesday, July 28, 2026**

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN** is running hot with 41 calls and only 153 hands on the board. Top scale hits **$54.75/hr**, and Ermco's got 20 slots on the Google Data Center in Mooresville—new outdoor construction, extensive background check required. Fluor Constructors is posting 9 JWs on Eli Lilly Lebanon at **$53.80 + 10% overscale**, 6-10s Monday-Saturday. This is new construction money with room to move.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** is stacked. Ten calls, 112 hands sitting, and Summit Line's pushing 39 Inside JW slots at flat **$55/hr with all OT double time**—you'll need your NM State JIW License (EE98J), but the math works. Rosendin's offering **$40 + $15 incentive for hitting 90% of a 60-hour week**, which can net you real money if you're willing to grind it.

**LU-237 Niagara Falls, NY** has Lake Mariner Data Center firing on all cylinders—Ferguson, O'Connell, and BESCO all hiring at **$48.20/hr**, 7-10s, 6:30 AM–5:00 PM, per diem available. Book depth is solid at 105 hands across just 7 calls; first shift is locked in.

**LU-545 St. Joseph, MO** is lean but lucrative. Seven calls, 21 hands—nearly clear. BVCI's got the Turney Energy Center referral at **$68.51/hr**. P1 Construction on the Clarios battery plant is **$52.69 + $5 overscale on the check**. These are short calls with real per diem potential.

**LU-430 Racine, WI** and **LU-890 Janesville, WI** are both feeding Microsoft Mount Pleasant and data work at **$62.51/hr**—bread-and-butter Midwest rates with long-sleeve requirements and 5-10 schedules locked in.

The market's consolidating around data centers and industrial manufacturing; if you're chasing sustainable work through fall, the Upper Midwest and Texas are where the books are thinning fastest.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Monday, July 27, 2026**

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** is eating right now—46 calls, ~140 hands deep, and NEW RIVER ELECT. CORP. is running dual-track: 40 JW linemen on 10-hour days in Columbus ($125/night PD + $125 bonus on the 10hr), and 9 more heading Southern Ohio distribution on 4-10s with optional weekends. Book 1 is wide open. CAPITAL ELECTRIC LINE BUILDERS has cable-splicing work in Johnstown (OSHA 10 + CDL A required). Distro rebuilds all the way down.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** — **$55.00/hr** flat, all OT double time across the board. Summit Line, Rosendin (with $15/hr incentive if you hold 90% of 60-hour weeks), and Cupertino are all burning through Inside JW slots on projects requiring NM State JIW License EE98J. Fire alarm and VESDA experience gets you B & D Industries. Thirty-nine calls through Summit alone means steady work.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** — **$44.80/hr** + **$100/day ND license bump + $150 weekend rate**. Parsons Electric is fronting the Polaris Forge Data Center build in Harwood (6-10s, $100/day non-taxed base PD). Hunt Electric anchors Grand Forks Air Base (4-10s + 8 Friday OT hours). 21 calls, 62 hands—tight board.

**LU-1547 Anchorage, AK** — **$76.59/hr top scale**. 47 calls but thin staffing (60 hands on the books means Book 1 moves fast). Golden Valley Electric Association is running an 8-week rotation at Healy Powerhouse; other slots in telecom and utility service work.

**LU-175 Chattanooga, TN** — Lawson Electric's data-center machine in Dalton, GA (DNN4) has 17 first-shift Inside JW calls + 7 night-shift (31.4% differential). Energy Solutions/Williams wants Inside JW for TVA nuclear plants (SQN & WBN)—requires TVA clearance.

Data centers and power infrastructure are pulling hands hardest; nuclear and government builds demand credentialing runway.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Monday, July 27, 2026**

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** is moving 20 calls across a tight board pushing nearly 74 hands out. BCS Mechanical's Sego Project West Valley is the anchor—28 JW plumber slots running 4-10s with full OT, plus 6 apprentice positions if you're still climbing. DSI's QTS Eagle Mountain data center play for PFers is solid at **$150/day per diem** (75-mile radius) on day shift work. Pipefab's North Salt Lake shop wants chrome-experienced fitters on steady 5-8s. Book 1 is moving fast here.

**LU-208 Denver, CO** has 21 calls but only ~48 hands available—the tightest ratio on the board. US Eng. Metalworks is running a heavy fab shop with 13 calls and stacking **15% shift differential** on all fitter work. Murphy's Corden Pharma Boulder job adds **15% incentive pay** plus **$125 per diem** if you're outside 100 miles. Rocky Mech's School of Mines boiler swap needs a foreman. This market is hungry.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** is pharma and refinery heavy with 10 calls. The Nutrien shutdown under BMWC is the crown jewel—**$16.50/hr hazard pay on OT/DT** if you're under 50 miles, or **$150/day per diem** if you're traveling. You'll need DISA current before you dispatch. Graham and Nooter are running parallel Cenovus work through September with fab shop and data center rolls attached.

**LU-213 St. John, NB** is pure Irving Oil Refinery work—7 calls, 32 hands, all journeyman pipefitters. Shift work is moving between day and night cycles; Stuart Olson and the unnamed contractor both have solid 4x10 schedules going.

**LU-290 Portland, OR** is service and specialty tech work—Charter Mechanical's Intel orbital welder positions at Ronler Acres are the standout, though these are tool install, not straight fab.

Refinery shutdowns and data center fab are pulling hands east and north; the West is tightening fast.
